top_signals.title: HSBC’s Kettner Sees Earnings, Valuations Buoying Risk Assets
top_signals.summary: Strong earnings growth and undemanding valuations are among the reasons keeping risk assets resilient to a more challenging inflation backdrop, according to HSBC Holdings Plc strategists.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: How can wealthy Scots save £46,000 on income tax? Commute from England
top_signals.summary: Higher earners in Scotland could save more than £46,000 in income tax over five years by moving south of the border and commuting to work, according to a new analysis by Rathbones. The wealth management firm found that a resident earning £250,000 could pay £8,900 less income tax in the first year alone by relocating [...]

top_signals.title: Immigration Services Agency to add 226 staff amid rise in foreign residents
top_signals.summary: The Immigration Services Agency will add 176 immigration inspectors, who review applications for residency status, and 50 immigration control officers.
